description: This file contains shell script code for testing and configuring pseudo-merge bitmap functionalities within a Git-related project. It defines multiple test cases, setup procedures, and utility functions to verify pseudo-merge behavior, coverage, overlapping groups, and boundary conditions in a Git repository environment.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges
methods.description: Runs a test tool to dump pseudo-merge data.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merge_commits
methods.description: Runs a test tool to dump pseudo-merge commit data for a given index.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges_satisfied
methods.description: Runs trace data verification for pseudo-merges satisfied condition with a specified parameter.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges_cascades
methods.description: Runs trace data verification for pseudo-merges cascades with a specified parameter.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges_reused
methods.description: Runs trace data verification to check pseudo-merge reuse functionality.

methods.name: tag_everything
methods.description: Creates tags for all commits in the repository.
